scope: Glenn L. Martin Hall (088), Jeong H. Kim Engineering Building (225), E. A. Fernandez IDEA Factory (228), A. James Clark Hall (429)
geometry: Horizontal building rings come from UMD_FULL_BUILDINGS, aligned to the shared Facilities GIS street transform. Floors, facade articulation and roof plant remain authored visual approximations; this is not a measured BIM or interior reconstruction.
